extracted.name: Air Fryer Oreos
extracted.description: Irresistible fried Oreos made in an air fryer with simple prepared ingredients. These are the perfect pick-me-up when you are craving carnival food!
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon confectioners' sugar, or to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the air fryer to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Line the air fryer basket with parchment paper. Spray parchment paper with cooking spray.
Mix pancake mix and water together in a bowl until well combined.
Dip each cookie into pancake mixture and place in the prepared basket, making sure they are not touching; cook in batches if necessary.
Cook in the preheated air fryer for 4 to 5 minutes; flip cookies and cook until golden brown, 2 to 3 minutes more.
Remove from air fryer and place on cooling rack.
